english: If one is unable to bestow a large gift, or perform a difficult austerity, or offer an elaborate sacrificelike the Jyotiṣṭoma and the rest, he should not he despondent on that account; on the contrary, he should "slowly" and gently "accumulate spiritual merit," by means of small gifts, small austerities, by helping others, to the best of his ability, and by muttering prayers and offering oblations prescribed in the Smṛtis; just in the same manner in which white ants accumulate the anthill.
